name: locomo-smoke-v1
purpose: Plumbing check: one command, a handful of real questions, a readable report. Never quote these numbers as a result.
selection_rule: For conversations conv-26/conv-43/conv-49 (indices 0/4/8), the first question of each LoCoMo category in file order (5 x 3 = 15), plus three questions that made the 2026-10-26 reader autopsy: conv-26 q32 (LGBTQ+ events), q50 (political leaning), q99 (counseling motivation).

excluded.why: strict clean holdout (191 unmined questions); smoke runs must never touch it
